points.title: 少年抗金
points.description: 辛弃疾出生于金国统治下的济南，祖父辛赞曾为宋臣，对金国怀有深仇。少年时期，辛弃疾目睹金人暴行，立志抗金复宋。1161年，金主完颜亮南侵，北方爆发耿京起义，辛弃疾聚众两千余人加入义军，任掌书记。他展现出非凡的军事才能，曾单骑追捕叛徒张安国，将其押回建康，表现出非凡的勇气和决断力。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Jinan under Jurchen Jin rule, Xin Qiji grew up witnessing Jin atrocities and developed a strong desire to resist the Jin and restore the Song. In 1161, when Jin Emperor Wanyan Liang invaded the south, the Geng Jing rebellion broke out in the north. Xin raised a force of 2,000 men and joined the rebellion as a secretary. He demonstrated exceptional military talent by single-handedly pursuing and capturing the traitor Zhang Guo, bringing him back to Jiankang, showing extraordinary courage and decisiveness.

points.title: 仕途初展
points.description: 1162年，辛弃疾南归南宋，受到宋高宗赏识，历任江阴判官、建康通判等职。在此期间，他积极上书献策，提出抗金复国方略，如《美芹十论》、《九议》等，展现其政治军事才能。1174年，他任湖南安抚使，在长沙创建飞虎军，训练精锐，成为南宋抗金的重要力量。然而，由于主和派当道，辛弃疾的军事才能和政治抱负难以施展，仕途屡受挫折。
points.descriptionEn: In 1162, Xin Qiji returned to the Southern Song and was appreciated by Emperor Gaozong. He served as officials in Jiangyin and Jiankang. During this period, he actively submitted memorials proposing strategies to resist the Jin and restore the Song, such as 'Ten Opinions on the Beautiful Celery' and 'Nine Discussions', showcasing his political and military talents. In 1174, as Hunan Pacification Commissioner, he established the Flying Tiger Army in Changsha, training elite troops that became an important force against the Jin. However, due to the dominance of the peace faction, his military abilities and political ambitions were difficult to realize, and his official career repeatedly encountered setbacks.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 1181年，辛弃疾因弹劾官吏被罢官，开始在江西上饶带湖闲居。这一时期是他文学创作的高峰期，创作了大量词作，如《青玉案·元夕》、《破阵子·为陈同甫赋壮词以寄之》等名篇。他的词作风格豪放，充满爱国情怀和英雄气概，被誉为'词中之龙'。同时，他仍心系国事，密切关注北方局势，不断上书献策，但未被朝廷采纳。这段隐居生活使他的词作更加深沉，既有豪放之气，又有婉约之情。
points.descriptionEn: In 1181, Xin Qiji was dismissed from office after impeaching an official and began living in seclusion at Daihu in Shangrao, Jiangxi. This period marked the peak of his literary creation, producing numerous famous ci poems such as 'Green Jade Cup: Lantern Festival' and 'Breaking the Formation: A Heroic Poem for Chen Tongfu'. His ci style was bold and unrestrained, filled with patriotic sentiment and heroic spirit, earning him the title 'Dragon Among Ci Poets'. Meanwhile, he remained concerned about national affairs, closely monitoring the northern situation and continuously submitting proposals, though they were not adopted by the court. This retirement life made his ci works more profound, combining both heroic and graceful elements.

points.title: 再起用事
points.description: 1192年，辛弃疾被重新起用，任福建提点刑狱。在福建期间，他整顿吏治，兴修水利，发展生产，政绩卓著。1194年，他又任福建安抚使，积极筹备抗金。然而，正当他准备大干一番时，朝廷再次将他罢官。这段短暂的复出使辛弃疾看到了南宋朝廷的软弱和腐败，也使他更加坚定了抗金的决心。在福建期间，他创作了《水龙吟·登建康赏心亭》等名篇，表达了对国家命运的忧虑和对个人遭遇的感慨。
points.descriptionEn: In 1192, Xin Qiji was reinstated as Circuit Intendant of Fujian. During his time in Fujian, he reformed administration, repaired water conservancy projects, and promoted production, achieving remarkable administrative results. In 1194, he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Fujian, actively preparing for resistance against the Jin. However, just as he was ready to make a significant impact, the court dismissed him again. This brief return to office made Xin see the weakness and corruption of the Southern Song court more clearly, and strengthened his determination to resist the Jin. During his Fujian period, he created famous works like 'Water Dragon Chant: Ascending Xinxing Pavilion in Jiankang', expressing his concern for the nation's fate and his personal frustrations.

points.title: 晚年归隐
points.description: 1195年，辛弃疾被再次罢官，回到江西铅山瓢泉闲居，直至去世。晚年生活虽然清贫，但他仍心系国事，创作了大量忧国忧民的作品。1203年，韩侂胄北伐，辛弃疾被短暂起用，但北伐失败后再次被贬。1207年，辛弃疾病逝于铅山，享年68岁。临终前，他仍高呼'杀贼'，表现出至死不渝的抗金决心。辛弃疾一生仕途坎坷，但文学成就卓著，与苏轼并称'苏辛'，是豪放派词人的代表，对中国文学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1195, Xin Qiji was dismissed again and returned to live in seclusion at Piaochuan in Yanshan, Jiangxi, until his death. Although his later years were financially modest, he remained concerned about national affairs and created many works expressing his worries for the country. In 1203, when Han Tuozhou launched a northern expedition, Xin was briefly reinstated, but after the expedition failed, he was demoted again. In 1207, Xin Qiji died in Yanshan at the age of 68. On his deathbed, he still shouted 'Kill the thieves', showing his unwavering determination to resist the Jin until his last breath. Xin Qiji's official career was full of frustrations, but his literary achievements were remarkable. Together with Su Shi, he is known as 'Su-Xin' and is a representative of the heroic school of ci poetry, having a profound influence on Chinese literature.

appraisal.zh: 辛弃疾通常被视为南宋最重要的爱国词人，与苏轼并称「苏辛」，其词豪放激昂，兼具军事才干与政治抱负，虽仕途屡遭贬谪而志节不改，成为后世爱国知识分子的象征。也有研究者指出，他过于强调武力抗金，所提北伐方案往往不切实际，性格刚直而不善权谋；其词亦有直白少含蓄之讥。但这些异议并不动摇他在文学史上的枢纽地位。
appraisal.en: Xin Qiji is generally regarded as the foremost patriotic ci poet of the Southern Song, ranked with Su Shi as "Su-Xin"; his bold, impassioned verse and his military and political aspirations, sustained through repeated demotion, made him an enduring symbol of the patriotic intellectual. Yet some researchers note that he overemphasized armed resistance, that his northern-expedition proposals were often impractical, and that his blunt temperament ill suited official maneuvering, while his ci can be faulted for plainness. Such objections do not unsettle his pivotal place in literary history.

supporter.zh: 辛弃疾是南宋伟大的爱国词人，一生以抗金复国为己任。他的词作豪放激昂，充满英雄气概和爱国情怀，开创了豪放词派，与苏轼并称'苏辛'。他不仅是杰出的文学家，更是具有军事才能和政治远见的爱国志士。即使在仕途坎坷、屡遭贬谪的情况下，他仍不改初衷，至死仍呼'杀贼'，体现了中华民族不屈不挠的精神。
supporter.en: Xin Qiji was a great patriotic poet of the Southern Song Dynasty, dedicating his life to resisting the Jin and restoring the Song. His ci poems are bold and passionate, filled with heroic spirit and patriotic sentiment, pioneering the heroic school of ci poetry. Together with Su Shi, he is known as 'Su-Xin'. He was not only an outstanding literary figure but also a patriotic scholar with military talent and political foresight. Despite a frustrating official career with repeated demotions, he never wavered in his original aspirations, shouting 'Kill the thieves' until his death, embodying the indomitable spirit of the Chinese nation.

critic.zh: 辛弃疾的政治生涯充满挫折，其军事才能和政治抱负未能充分施展。他过于强调武力抗金，忽视了南宋国力衰弱的现实，提出的北伐方案往往不切实际。在官场中，他性格刚直，不善权谋，多次因弹劾他人而遭贬谪。此外，他的词作虽有豪放之气，但也存在过于直白、缺乏含蓄之美的局限，与婉约派相比，艺术表现力有所不足。
critic.en: Xin Qiji's political career was filled with frustrations, and his military talent and political ambitions were not fully realized. He overemphasized military resistance against the Jin, neglecting the reality of the Southern Song's declining national power, and his proposed northern expeditions were often impractical. In officialdom, his straightforward personality and poor political maneuvering led to multiple demotions after impeaching others. Furthermore, while his ci poems possess bold spirit, they sometimes lack the subtlety and gracefulness of the graceful school, making their artistic expression less refined compared to that school.

objective.zh: 辛弃疾是中国文学史上承前启后的重要人物，其词作融合了豪放与婉约两种风格，开创了宋词新境界。作为南宋爱国词人的代表，他的作品不仅是文学瑰宝，更是研究南宋历史的重要史料。在当代文化中，辛弃疾已成为爱国知识分子的象征，其'壮志未酬身先死'的悲剧命运引发广泛共鸣。他的生平和作品被多次改编为影视、戏剧作品，成为中国传统文化的重要组成部分。
objective.en: Xin Qiji is a pivotal figure in Chinese literary history, bridging the gap between earlier and later periods. His ci works blend both heroic and graceful styles, creating a new realm in Song poetry. As a representative of Southern Song patriotic poets, his works are not only literary treasures but also important historical materials for studying the Southern Song period. In contemporary culture, Xin Qiji has become a symbol of patriotic intellectuals, and his tragic fate of dying before fulfilling his ambitions resonates widely. His life and works have been adapted into films, TV shows, and plays, becoming an important part of traditional Chinese culture.

self.zh: 醉里挑灯看剑，梦回吹角连营。八百里分麾下炙，五十弦翻塞外声。沙场秋点兵。
self.en: Drunk, I light the lamp to examine my sword; in dreams, I hear the horns echoing through the camp. Eight hundred miles away, roasted meat is distributed under my command; fifty-string instruments play frontier tunes. On the autumn battlefield, troops are being mustered.
